subject: Class 378/2 Capitalstar, London Overground, 2024-2026: DMOS (cab) and MOS (next); original livery default, refreshed as a variant
method: Heights from bodyside photos (p208 columns, 1D fit with cantrail line 3.28 m and body bottom 0.95 m from the diagram/377); door and window positions from three photos (p208, p204, pside) by 1D projective fits along the cantrail/waist lines, because the Unisouth 378 diagram is a pixel copy of the 377 drawing. Face measured head-on on p224 (1D projective fit across the face with symmetric pairs, scale fixed by the vertical calibration). Every number has its source in `trace`. Sides: 'near' = the bodyside on the train's RIGHT looking forward from the cab = negative m on the face.

dia.notes: Same pixel grid as the 377 drawing (door columns 442-585/1198-1341 identical to the 377's 442-586/1198-1341): its door and window positions are not independent evidence and are not used.

p224.horizontal: u = c0 + K m/(1 + C m), c0 3014.5, K 376.3 px/m, C 0.0212; fitted to 7 symmetric pairs (door seals, coupler recess, bezel outer tops, head/tail lamp centres, bezel inner bottoms, screen outer edges), residuals <= 1.5 px except bezel outer top 6.5 px and bezel inner bottom 9 px (soft edges)
p224.vertical: y = 0.97 + (vg(u) - v)/s(u) with vg = 2044.5 - 0.0255 (u - 2560) (blue band bottom = seal bottom, 0.97 m) and s = 380 px/m from orange cap line at the centre (v 1131.5) = 3.37 m against the 377's 3.29 m line plus the 378's higher dome; cross-check: screen surround height 1.90-3.29 m vs 377 1.875-3.27

p208.horizontal: x = xn + K (u - un)/(u - uinf); uinf -80.4 px from the convergence of the cantrail and waist lines (45 columns, residual 0.5 px rms), nose tip un 2560 px = 0.10 m, DMOS rear end 887 px = 19.945 m (19.995 less the end seam)
p208.vertical: per column: cantrail orange line centre = 3.28 m, waist orange top = 1.27 m

pside.notes: 2009 DMOS side, oblique: vanishing point fitted so that both doors' leaf pairs are 1.5 m and symmetric about their seals (residual 0.05 m); rear end 2449 px = 19.995 m

p204.notes: cantrail/waist convergence uinf 5137 px (39 columns, 0.4 px rms); anchors nose 842 px = 0 and DMOS rear 2248 px = 19.995 m

trace.liveries.LO.doorStripes.xy: From the reading (s-door-tmd07): on each leaf's meeting edge, 0.06 m wide (x 0-0.06 from the door centre), from 0.06 below the leaf top (span top 3.10 -> 3.04) down to 0.35 of the leaf height above its bottom (0.97 + 0.35 x 2.13 = 1.72). Drawn plain yellow: the black zigzag on it is not drawn (a stripe is one colour).
trace.liveries.LO.cabLowerBlue: The lower cab corner is blue: on p208 (378208, three-quarter of the cab) the blue band runs on round the corner and down the face's lower part to the bottom of the valance, under the yellow; the render had the nose's skirt below the bodyside (y < 0.95) in the body white. Painted blue from the nose to the cab door's rear edge (1.67 + 0.37 = 2.04) up to the band's top (1.215), under the doors.
trace.liveries.LO.choice: The livery rule (2026-10-06, FLEET.md): each class x operator renders the livery most units carry today; on a near tie, the newer scheme. 378: latest photo of each unit (classes/378/notes.md): original 46 of 57; photos dated 2022-2026 only, original 31 of 42. Not a near tie: the original scheme (liveries.LO) stays the default; the refreshed one is recorded as liveries.LO-refreshed.
